# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 41 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 38 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_041_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 41

**1** Jesus said: "Whoever has something in hand will be given more, and whoever has nothing — even what little he has will be taken from him."

---

**Consensus Notes (SOPHIA):**

**"In hand"** — LOGOS/EMET preferred; preserves the Coptic's specific idiom of active possession.

**Synoptic Parallels:**
- Matt 13:12; 25:29: "To everyone who has, more will be given... but from him who has not, even what he has will be taken away"
- Mark 4:25; Luke 8:18; 19:26: Same saying
- This is among the most widely attested Jesus sayings; Thomas's version is the most compact
